definitions.explanation: A flat horizontal surface attached to a wall or in a frame, used for storing or displaying things.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{棚|たな}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}いて→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please put the book on the shelf.

examples.japanese: {棚|たな}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{本棚|ほんだな}→本棚：04489_hondana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}いました→買う：00489_kau⟧。

notes:
{棚|たな} is a general word for any shelf, rack, or shelving unit. It appears in many compound words where it specifies the type of shelf.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{本棚|ほんだな}→本棚：04489_hondana⟧: bookshelf
- ⟦{食器棚|しょっきだな}→食器棚：07097_shokkidana⟧: cupboard, dish cabinet
- ⟦{戸棚|とだな}→戸棚：04073_todana⟧: cupboard, cabinet (with doors)
- ⟦{神棚|かみだな}→神棚：13740_kamidana⟧: household Shinto altar shelf
- ⟦{棚|たな}{卸|おろ}し→棚卸し：07940_tanaoroshi⟧: stocktaking, inventory check

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {棚|たな}に⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：00546_ageru⟧: to shelve (an issue); also means to ignore one's own faults while criticizing others
- {棚|たな}から⟦ぼた{餅|もち}→ぼた餅：noentry⟧: unexpected good fortune (lit. rice cake falling from a shelf)

USAGE:
In compounds, {棚|たな} often becomes -だな due to rendaku (sequential voicing).
